predecessor.requirement: Do not claim or mutate the H200 until the predecessor terminal is durable and its claim is released.

resident_contents.requirement: Verify the retained target, draft, source, image, caches, and resident manifest in place; do not restage immutable bytes that already match.

patch.scope: One behavior line plus its explanatory comment; set DFlashDraftInputV2.direct_carry_valid to false.

execution_contract.first_and_required_measurement: Apply the bound patch to the exact runtime and run exactly one fresh oracle request. Persist draft tokens, verifier top-1 logits and IDs, accepted prefix, bonus token, KV write positions and locations, committed length before and after, next-cycle seed and length, and the same-state ordinary AR token.
execution_contract.quality_gate: dflash_cycle_oracle.py must pass every captured cycle and prove same-state ordinary-AR equality.
execution_contract.failure_terminal: If the one-request oracle fails, persist DFLASH_CYCLE_ORACLE_TERMINAL.json with the first divergent field, stop all processes, and release the bench. Do not run a four-request diagnostic, c32 measurement, or endpoint pair.
execution_contract.conditional_measurement: Only after the oracle passes, measure DFlash-specific c32 draft and verifier time at depths 4, 8, 12, and 16 and feed those measured costs to the bound controller.
execution_contract.success_terminal: Persist DFLASH_CYCLE_ORACLE_TERMINAL.json with oracle evidence, depth costs, and the controller decision, then stop all processes and release the bench.
forbidden: Do not replay the consumed four-request producer.
Do not infer quality from the semantically invalid historical acceptance histogram.
Do not run a matched endpoint pair in this phase.
Do not apply another scientific repair.

successor.requirement: Release the warm H200 by the absolute deadline so the already-reserved grouped LM-head experiment retains a 90-minute window before its 21:45Z release boundary.
